items.name: alert-dialog
items.title: Alert Dialog
items.description: Confirmation dialog with confirm and cancel actions, a destructive tone, an async onConfirm that stays open while pending and shows failures inline, and an optional type-to-confirm phrase.

items.name: avatar
items.title: Avatar
items.description: Material 3 avatar that falls back from a photo to initials to a person glyph, with a stable tonal colour from the name, five sizes, two shapes, a presence dot, a button twin and an overlapping group with a +N overflow.

items.name: badge
items.title: Badge
items.description: Material 3 badge as a small dot or a count that caps at 99+, in five tones, with a screen reader label and an anchor that pins it to the top-end corner of an icon or avatar.

items.name: banner
items.title: Banner
items.description: Inline message and top-of-page banner in five status tones, tonal or outlined, with a default glyph per tone, text-button actions, a dismiss button and a polite status region that becomes an alert for announced errors.

items.name: button-group
items.title: Button Group
items.description: Material 3 button group, standard or connected, horizontal or vertical, that gives its buttons a shared size, variant and tone.

items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: Material 3 button in five variants and five sizes, with icons, a destructive tone, a link twin and automatic pending state for async actions.

items.name: card
items.title: Card
items.description: Material 3 elevated, filled and outlined cards with header, media, content and footer parts, link and button cards, selectable checkbox and radio cards, and automatic surface steps when cards nest.

items.name: checkbox
items.title: Checkbox
items.description: Material 3 checkbox with an animated check mark, indeterminate state, labels and descriptions, plus a checkbox group with validation and a built-in select-all checkbox.

items.name: chip
items.title: Chip
items.description: Material 3 chips for filtering, choosing and entering values, as a keyboard-navigable group with single or multiple selection and removable input chips, plus standalone assist and filter chips.

items.name: color-scheme
items.title: Colour scheme
items.description: Generates every Material 3 role plus success, warning and info from one seed colour at runtime, matching MaterialKolor on mobile.

items.name: combo-box
items.title: Combo box
items.description: Searchable select on the shared Field contract that ignores case and accents, matches item keywords, loads results as you type, accepts custom values, picks one or several options and clears with one press.

items.name: content-state
items.title: Content State
items.description: Switches between loading, error, empty and content for data you fetch, from an explicit status or from data and error, with default copy you can replace, an async retry, a skeleton slot and a refresh-error banner over stale content.

items.name: copy-button
items.title: Copy Button
items.description: Copies a string or an async value to the clipboard, confirms with a check and a screen-reader announcement, and reports failures; icon-only or with a label.

items.name: dialog
items.title: Dialog
items.description: Material 3 modal dialog with header, scrolling body and actions, five sizes, a centred hero icon, dismissal control and a full-screen layout with a top app bar on phones.

items.name: disclosure
items.title: Disclosure
items.description: Expandable section with a heading trigger, optional icon and description, and an animated panel, plus an Accordion that groups disclosures as plain, outlined or separated lists.

items.name: divider
items.title: Divider
items.description: Material 3 divider on React Aria Separator, horizontal or vertical, full width or with a start or middle inset, and an optional centred label such as a localised “or”.

items.name: ds-provider
items.title: DSProvider
items.description: Supplies locale, client-side routing, message overrides, icons and the motion preference to every component.

items.name: dynamic-color
items.title: Dynamic colour
items.description: Runtime Material 3 schemes as scoped CSS, seed colours ranked from an image with Material's content-based quantizer and score, and a boot script that paints a stored theme before hydration.

items.name: dynamic-theme
items.title: Dynamic theme
items.description: Applies a scheme generated from a seed colour to a subtree or to the whole page, following light, dark and contrast, with a cached boot script for user-chosen themes and an animated theme switch.

items.name: empty-state
items.title: Empty State
items.description: Centred placeholder for empty tables, lists and whole pages, with an icon or illustration, a real heading, a description and primary and secondary actions in three sizes.

items.name: fab
items.title: FAB
items.description: Material 3 floating action button in three sizes and four colours, with an extended form that shrinks on scroll and a FAB menu for two to six related actions.

items.name: field
items.title: Field
items.description: The shared contract every input follows, with a label and necessity indicator, description, error message, character counter and outlined and filled controls in three sizes.

items.name: i18n
items.title: Localisation helpers
items.description: The 18 supported locales, per-component message catalogues, locale resolution and direction.

items.name: icon-button
items.title: Icon Button
items.description: Material 3 icon button in four variants, five sizes and two shapes, with a toggle twin, a link twin, a destructive tone and automatic pending state for async actions.

items.name: icons
items.title: Icons
items.description: The Material Symbols Rounded glyphs the library draws itself; every one can be replaced through DSProvider.

items.name: kbd
items.title: Kbd
items.description: Keyboard key hints, one key or a shortcut combination that shows ⌘ on Apple platforms and Ctrl elsewhere, with full key names for screen readers.

items.name: link
items.title: Link
items.description: Text link in an inline and a standalone style, with an optional forward arrow, external links that announce the new tab, router navigation and a disabled state.

items.name: list-box
items.title: List box
items.description: Selectable list on React Aria ListBox, with sections, start icons or avatars, descriptions, a check mark for selected rows, two densities, an empty state and load-more.

items.name: menu
items.title: Menu
items.description: Material 3 menu that opens from a button or a right click, with icons, descriptions, shortcut hints that follow the platform, sections, check-mark selection, nested submenus, link items and a destructive tone.

items.name: motion
items.title: Motion tokens
items.description: Spatial and effect springs, durations and easings shared with the Compose design system.

items.name: number-field
items.title: Number field
items.description: Counter and quantity stepper on the shared Field contract, with minus and plus or stacked chevrons, locale-aware currency, percent and unit formats, a checkout-sized display size and an optional rolling odometer.

items.name: password-field
items.title: Password field
items.description: Password input on the shared Field contract, with a reveal toggle, a Caps Lock warning, the right autocomplete hint and an optional strength meter and requirements checklist for new passwords.

items.name: popover
items.title: Popover
items.description: Material 3 popover surface anchored to a trigger, with placement, an optional arrow, motion that grows from the trigger, and a dialog part with a title and close button for small forms.

items.name: progress
items.title: Progress
items.description: Material 3 linear and circular progress indicators, determinate or indeterminate, with a track gap, a stop dot, four tones, two thicknesses, an expressive wavy variant and value labels formatted for the locale.

items.name: radio-group
items.title: Radio Group
items.description: Material 3 radio group with per-option descriptions, vertical or horizontal layout and a card variant for plan and option pickers.

items.name: search-field
items.title: Search field
items.description: Search input on the shared Field contract, with a clear button and Escape to clear, submit on Enter, a pending spinner for async search, a focus shortcut with its key hint and a Material 3 pill shape for top bars.

items.name: segmented-control
items.title: Segmented Control
items.description: Material 3 segmented button for one or several choices, with a check on selected segments, plus a thumb style whose filled thumb slides to the selection.

items.name: select
items.title: Select
items.description: Field-styled select on the shared Field contract, with icons and avatars in the value, sections, single or multiple selection shown as text, a count or chips, and async loading.

items.name: sheet
items.title: Sheet
items.description: Material 3 sheet that slides in from the start, end, top or bottom edge, with sizes per side, header, body and footer parts, and bottom sheets that drag to dismiss, rest at snap points or stay open beside the page.

items.name: skeleton
items.title: Skeleton
items.description: Loading placeholders in text, circle and rectangle shapes that follow the line height, shimmer in the reading direction and can wrap real content until it has loaded.

items.name: slider
items.title: Slider
items.description: Material 3 Expressive slider with one value or a range, three track sizes, stop indicators, labelled marks, a centred fill, a value bubble while dragging, vertical orientation and locale-aware formatting.

items.name: spinner
items.title: Spinner
items.description: A small decorative spinner that inherits the current text colour and size, for pending buttons, chips and inline status text.

items.name: switch
items.title: Switch
items.description: Material 3 switch with a growing handle, optional handle icons, label at either side, descriptions and a full-width row layout for settings pages.

items.name: tabs
items.title: Tabs
items.description: Material 3 primary and secondary tabs plus a pill variant, with a spring indicator that follows the selection, icons, badges, scrolling with fade edges and a vertical layout.

items.name: tag
items.title: Tag
items.description: Compact status labels for tables and lists in six tones and three variants, with an optional dot or icon, plus a keyboard-navigable TagGroup for removable or selectable tags in forms.

items.name: text-area
items.title: Text area
items.description: Multi-line input on the shared Field contract that grows with its content between a minimum and maximum number of rows, with a character counter.

items.name: text-field
items.title: Text field
items.description: Single-line input on the shared Field contract, with start and end adornments, a clear button, a character counter and native types for email, URL and phone.

items.name: theme-scope
items.title: Theme scope
items.description: Carries the nearest dynamic theme scope to overlays that portal out of it, so popovers, menus and dialogs keep the scheme of the element that opened them.

items.name: theme
items.title: Theme
items.description: Material 3 colour roles, type scale, shapes, elevation, motion tokens and the state-layer and focus-ring utilities, generated from one seed colour.

items.name: toast
items.title: Toast
items.description: Material 3 snackbar toasts with a global toast() API, status tones, actions, promise and in-place updates, six logical placements and a stack that fans out on hover or keyboard focus.

items.name: toggle-button
items.title: Toggle Button
items.description: Material 3 Expressive toggle button whose shape morphs between a capsule and a rounded square, plus a group for single or multiple selection.

items.name: tooltip
items.title: Tooltip
items.description: Material 3 plain and rich tooltips that open on hover and keyboard focus, with keyboard shortcut hints, a shared group for toolbars and an interactive rich variant with an action.

items.name: use-controllable-state
items.title: useControllableState
items.description: State that works controlled through value and onChange, or uncontrolled from a default.

items.name: use-image-seed
items.title: useImageSeed
items.description: Ranks seed colours from an image URL, file or element, for themes that follow a photo, cover or avatar.

items.name: use-local-storage-state
items.title: useLocalStorageState
items.description: State kept in localStorage, synchronised across components and tabs, with a server value for static rendering.

items.name: use-media-query
items.title: useMediaQuery
items.description: Subscribes to a CSS media query, with a server value for static rendering.

items.name: utils
items.title: Utilities
items.description: cn() and a tv() preconfigured to merge the Material 3 type scale and elevation utilities.
